Lyrics are searched on LRCLIB, then NetE:
Lyrics are searched on LRCLIB, then NetEase, SyncLRC, LrcShare and LRC.cx in turn. The title, artist and track length are sent for the search (the album only to LRCLIB). Karaoke uses real timestamps only; plain lyrics can be read and scrolled without automatic progression. No line is highlighted during an instrumental intro. A player with a system media session and notification access is required.

A positive offset delays the lines (when they appear ahead of the music); a negative offset advances them (when they lag behind).
